Quick answers:
- We're generally happy to grant a short-form permission for the quote and logo.
- We typically ask for a one-page release with a quick legal sign-off and a final approval pass on the copy and screenshot before publish.

Marissa / Grace — can you please advise on the standard release form and any branding constraints? Hannah, I've attached the Novum PDF back into this thread.

Thanks Jordan / Hannah.

We can approve a marketing use release with a couple of small asks. I've attached a redline for the marketing terms (redlines_novum_marketing_terms.docx) — summary below:

- Scope: One short customer spotlight for Novum-owned channels (website, social, newsletter). Allow Redwood to repost/share for cross-promotion.
- Quote: Use the exact quoted sentence; Novum will have one final approval pass on the published copy.
- Logo: Novum to provide high-res raster + vector logos. Redwood will follow Novum brand guidelines for spacing and colors.
- Attribution: Include the contributor name and title (Hannah Li, Head of Marketing).
- Duration: 24 months with option to renew; removal request honored within 10 business days.

Grace — please confirm the logo variant we need (full-color vs mono) and any safe-zone constraints. Hannah, if the terms look fine we can route a signed PDF back to you today; otherwise note any requested edits.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick brand ops note from my side.

Thanks Marissa, that scope looks good. For implementation we need:
- Novum to provide: full-color PNG (300dpi), white-background vector (AI or EPS), and a mono/one-color version for dark backgrounds.
- Preferred filename convention: Novum_Logo_Horiz_RGB.png and Novum_Logo_Vert_EPS.ai.
- For the screenshot: please crop to 16:9 and hide any PHI in the dashboard (Tom, can you confirm the mock contains only anonymized data?).

Hannah — once we have the logo pack and your confirmation on the data in the screenshot, I will run a layout review and then Marissa can issue the release PDF. Expected turn: layout review within 24 hours, final signed release same day.

Cheers,
